note: The bands the Cub plant has to land in, from docs/CUB-STAGE1.md, which derives each from published figures for the FMS Piper J-3 Cub 1400 mm (scripts/cub-derive.js prints the derived figures). Never widened to pass; argue in the derivation instead.

c1_level_75.source: level speed at 75 percent throttle, derived 16.6. Re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 11 x 7 curve (prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/cub-derive.js): was 13.4 on the straight line, the band 11.5 to 15.5 re-centred in the same proportion, 0.858 to 1.157 of the derived figure. Re-derived 2026-10-11 again with the stick put through the electric motor's own law, n^2 + 5.667 n = 6.667 d (plant_wing.c prop_spool, scripts/lib/propcurve.js electricN): the derivation had flown the stick as the prop's speed share, which the plant has not held since its motor law changed; 75 percent turns the prop at 0.776, derived 17.22, was 16.6; the same 0.858 to 1.157 of it Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat): derived 18.7, was 17.22; the same 0.858 to 1.157 of it.

c2_stall.source: sqrt(2W / rho S CLmax), derived 8.1; alphaStall is CLmax / CLalpha, 1.15 / 5.21, of the zero lift line Re-derived 2026-10-11: alphaStall over the wing's own slope, a_w 4.887 (scripts/cub-derive.js), not the wing and tail's 5.21: the stall angle is the wing's and the tail's share lifts on past it, as the Extra's (#935); was 0.2207293666026871. And the band with it: the plant's CLmax is the wing's 1.150 plus the tail's share at that angle, (CLa - a_w) sin a cos a = 0.073, so the formula's speeds go by sqrt(1.150 / 1.223) = 0.9696.

c4_top.source: level speed at full throttle, derived 22.4. Re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 11 x 7 curve (prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/cub-derive.js): was 18.4 on the straight line, the band 16.8 to 20.7 re-centred in the same proportion, 0.913 to 1.125 of the derived figure Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat): derived 23.55, was 22.4; the same 0.913 to 1.125 of it.

c5_roll.source: full aileron from the fastest the Cub flies, as the helix angle pb/2V, derived 0.155 (152 deg/s at 12 m/s)

c6_turn.source: radius against V^2 / (g tan bank) at the bank and speed flown

c7_climb.source: full throttle, best over a sweep of airspeeds, derived 7.9 at 12.9 m/s. Re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 11 x 7 curve (prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/cub-derive.js): was 4.9 at 10.1 m/s on the straight line, the band 3.4 to 5.8 re-centred in the same proportion, 0.694 to 1.184 of the derived figure; 12.9 m/s is still inside the sweep Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat): derived 8.54 at 13.40 m/s, was 7.94 at 12.90; the same 0.691 to 1.178 of it.

c8_throw.source: a throw at 10 m/s, 70 percent, for two seconds the up stick that trims 10 m/s (1.87 deg of elevator through the expo); airborne and flying after three

c9_chop.source: throttle off from cruise, pitch stick neutral: a glide, not a tumble

c10_phugoid.source: the phugoid root of the four state longitudinal model about the state the gate flies, 65 percent with the sticks centred, derived 7.71 s (zeta 0.23), at 12.07 m/s climbing 1.13 m/s; the band is the Skyhunter's in proportion. Re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 11 x 7 curve (prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/cub-derive.js): was 7.1 s trimmed level at the 11.2 m/s 65 percent held on the straight line, where level flight wanted 0.62 deg of elevator, near enough centred to stand for the gate's sticks. On the curve 65 percent holds 14.2 m/s level only on 1.15 deg of down elevator, which the gate never gives, so the derivation now solves the sticks centred state itself (on the straight line that gives 7.58 s); the band 5.8 to 8.3 re-centred in the same proportion, 0.817 to 1.169 of the derived figure. Trimmed level at 14.2 m/s instead it would be 9.11 s. Re-derived 2026-10-11 again with the stick put through the electric motor's own law, n^2 + 5.667 n = 6.667 d (plant_wing.c prop_spool, scripts/lib/propcurve.js electricN): the derivation had flown the stick as the prop's speed share, which the plant has not held since its motor law changed; 65 percent turns the prop at 0.683, the sticks centred state 12.06 m/s climbing 1.64, derived 7.79 s (zeta 0.23), was 7.71; the same 0.817 to 1.169 of it. Trimmed level instead, 14.99 m/s on 1.46 deg of down elevator, it would be 9.72 s Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat): derived 7.92 s from the sticks centred state, 12.01 m/s climbing 2.60, was 7.79; the same 0.816 to 1.169 of it.

c11_sideslip.source: full rudder, wings held level: -Cndr dr / Cnb, derived 13.5, the wind from the left

c12_yaw_rate.source: full rudder, ailerons centred: the Dutch roll step's peak rate, derived 39 Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat): the gate steps the rudder at the 65 percent stick (wingpilot.js rudderStep), whose level speed the derivation now puts at 16.48 m/s, was 14.99; wn goes with the speed and zeta and the sideslip do not, so the peak rate goes with it, and the band moves by 16.48 / 14.99 = 1.099 (cub:derive prints the step at that speed, 53.9 deg/s).

c13_rudder_roll.source: full rudder, ailerons centred: bank after 2 s, the rudder's way, from dihedral; steady roll rate derived 25 deg/s

c14_prop_torque.source: static full throttle, rolling left: ideal disc power 0.152, bench electrical power 0.28 Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat): derived the static figures times the speed share squared the gates' pack turns the prop at standing, 1.028^2 = 1.057 (HobbyKing's 10.93 V bench under the 4.1 V pack's), ideal disc power 0.161, was 0.152; the same 0.130 to 0.300 of it.

c15_pfactor.source: full throttle at 8.9 m/s, 1.1 Vs, at the 5.46 deg of body alpha level flight needs there, nose left: 1.6 T V sin(alpha) / Omega, derived 0.0183 on 11.34 N of thrust; the band is kappa from 1 to 3. Re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 11 x 7 curve (prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/cub-derive.js): was 0.0136 on 8.44 N on the straight line, the band 0.008 to 0.026, now kappa 1 to 3 on the new thrust, 0.0115 to 0.0343 Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat): derived 0.0192 N m on 11.88 N, was 0.0183 on 11.34 N; the same 0.628 to 1.874 of it.

c16_rest.source: the drawn model at rest, 11.0 deg and 0.146 m, 14.4 percent on the tail

c17_takeoff.source: full throttle on grass, tail up at about 7 m/s, rotated at 1.1 Vs: derived 4.95 m and 8.9 m/s (asphalt 4.74 m). Re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 11 x 7 curve (prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/cub-derive.js): was 6.2 m (asphalt 5.9) on the straight line, the distance band 4.5 to 9.0 re-centred in the same proportion, 0.721 to 1.442 of the derived figure; the speed band is the rotation's and does not move Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat): derived 4.69 m on grass, was 4.95; the distance band the same 0.721 to 1.442 of it, 3.38 to 6.76; the speed band is the rotation's and does not move.

c18_straight.source: the same take off with the rudder centred: the tailwheel holds the line against the torque

c19_taxi.source: full right rudder, the turn settled: cub:derive's steady taxi turn on the plant's own coefficients, tyres and ground effect, 2.312 m at 2.63 m/s at 30 percent. Re-derived 2026-10-11: was 2.0 to 3.5 m about the wheels alone, wheelbase / tan(steer), 0.679 / tan 15 deg, 2.5 m, at 35 percent over seconds 3 to 5. The wheels alone leave out the tyres' slip and the air at taxi (the rudder in the prop's wash, the yaw damping, the fin in the stalled wing's wake), and at 35 percent there is no steady turn to measure: the derivation's, 1.47 m, is not one the plant holds, its tail breaking away into a seven second cycle (speed 1.7 to 3.0 m/s), so the radius over seconds 3 to 5 was a moment of that cycle, 2.11 m and 1.92 with the ground effect. At 28, 30 and 32 percent the plant settles and agrees with the derivation within 1.7 percent (2.427, 2.342, 2.198 m against 2.419, 2.328, 2.160; with the ground effect 2.421, 2.321, 2.134 against 2.415, 2.312, 2.114); under 26 percent the Cub does not roll. The band is the derivation's 2.312 with that 1.7 percent and the radius' spread over a tenth more or less grip on each tyre (mu ESTIMATED, plant.c: -3.1 and +2.5 percent on the tailwheel, +2.4 and -2.0 on the mains), root summed, 3.7 and 3.5 percent: 5.4 under and 5.2 over. Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas, 3.642, through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat): at 30 percent the seated pack turns the prop 11 percent faster (2,977 rpm against 2,672) and there is no steady turn to measure, the tail breaking away into an eight second cycle (radius 2.5 to 0.7 m, yaw to 153 deg/s), as at 35 percent before; the derivation's own sweep shows the radius falling through it, 1.772 m with the ground at 30 percent. The turn is flown at 27 percent, where the prop turns as fast as 30 percent's did (2,698 rpm) and the plant settles: cub:derive 2.289 m at 2.67 m/s with the ground (2.308 in free air), was 2.312 at 2.63 at 30 percent. At 26, 27 and 28 percent the plant settles at 2.417, 2.342, 2.241 m against the derivation's 2.362, 2.289, 2.186 with the ground, within 2.5 percent; a tenth more and less grip at 27 percent moves it -3.5 and +2.7 percent on the tailwheel, +2.7 and -2.2 on the mains, root summed 4.1 and 3.9: the band is 6.6 under and 6.4 over, 2.14 to 2.43.

c20_landing.source: a powered approach, flare and hold the tail down: at rest on three wheels at C16's attitude, no hull contact

c21_prop_strike.source: full down elevator at full throttle on the take off roll: the aircraft pitches over its mains until the prop, which clears the grass by 25 mm level, strikes at about 9 deg nose down

c22_unmoved.source: the five inch's canonical replay hash, the wing's and the Skyhunter's recorded flight hashes in Node, all from before the Cub existed; the Cub must move none of them. Re-recorded for crash round 4 aero (#59), from its merged build, with the owner's sign-off on the stall after flying it: sky each cross the stall (docs/STALL-STAGE1.md, npm run stall:crossing); the five inch, the wing and the Slow Stick are unchanged Every recorded flight re-recorded again for aero round 6's fix, the table's rotary derivatives applied in the stability axes, one commit per recording from that build, on the owner's approval of the fix on 2026-09-26: each moves short of the stall as well (docs/STALL-STAGE1.md, Round 6). The fixed wings' hashes were re-recorded on 2026-09-27 when their packs and tanks began to drain, the owner's decision (docs/POWER-STAGE1.md); the five inch's is unchanged. Re-pinned for the prop's slipstream and its gyroscope on every prop (docs/FLIGHTMODEL.md): the recordings flown under power moved; the five inch's is as it was. Re-pinned 2026-10-13 (w38-fuselage-side): the recordings that fly sideways moved with their fuselage's crossflow drag taken on the drawn sections, not a round body's (side_cda, NACA TN 3038 through scripts/lib/crossflow.js), and with the AS3X gains re-derived on it (as3x:derive) (were f025098b3e73e796).

c23_cross_host.source: the Cub's recorded take off and flight, state trace hash, Node against headless Chrome

stab_straight.source: thrown level at 12 m/s, 3 m up, 0.75 throttle, every stick centred in Stabilised: the cross track after 10 s, left positive as the plant's y. Derived (npm run stab:straight, scripts/lib/throwflight.js): the CAP's throw (cap580:derive throwFlight) for this table, the body's six rates at the plant's step on the table's own coefficients, the motor spooled from the throw on its own law and its torque on the mount, right thrust where the table has it, the P factor, the jet normal force, the prop's gyroscope, the slipstream's terms with the swirl's force on the whole stream (scripts/lib/wash.js finSwirl, Deters, Ananda and Selig 2015, AIAA 2015-2265, fig. 22b), and Stabilised's loops with ArduPilot's roll integrator: derived 15.84 m. Against the plant (w36-physics): the cross track within 0.039 m along the curve at 0.5, 1, 2, 3, 5, 10 s (plant 15.80 m), the bank within 0.003 deg and the heading within 0.007 deg; with the drive's torque off the mount (sim_wing_set_mount(0)) within 0.020 m of the derived 9.68. Held within 0.09 m either way: the worst agreement of the two and the same again for what the model leaves out (the pack's drain, the ground's effect), and the derived figure's rounding, 0.01 m. Was: under 15 m off the line, a figure with no source, red at 15.7 m on the combined plant. ESTIMATED: the drift is the swirl's yaw with no right thrust against it. docs/CUB-STAGE1.md says the swirl "is what the kit's built in right thrust is for", but nothing gives its angle: FMS's manual for the 1400 mm J-3 V4 (Horizon Hobby, FMM106P Manual EN) names the 3536-850KV motor and no thrust offset, side or down, and the motor's mount is moulded into the foam. The table carries none (thrust_yaw 0), so this band holds the plant to its derivation, not to the real Cub, until the angle is measured off an airframe. The airspeed at 10 s by the same rule: derived 16.88 m/s, the plant 16.83, within 0.044 along the curve, held within 0.1.
